description: This PHP script demonstrates the usage of the TestLink API to automate setup tasks such as creating test projects, test plans, builds, and platforms for testing purposes. It includes functions for each step, leveraging SOAP/XMLRPC calls via the IXR_Client class.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A client class used for making XMLRPC calls to the TestLink server.

methods.name: createTestProject
methods.description: Creates a new test project in TestLink using API call.

methods.name: createTestPlan
methods.description: Creates a new test plan within a specific test project.

methods.name: createBuild
methods.description: Creates a new build associated with a test plan.

methods.name: createPlatform
methods.description: Adds a new platform to the test project.

search-terms: PHP API usage for test management
